purpose: Rebuild one bounded part of an existing plan -- a roadmap slice or a single database item -- leaving everything else untouched.
evidenceRule: Rebuilt items cite only evidence present in the supplied pack. Nothing outside the requested scope may be returned.
instructions: Rebuild only what the task names and return only that. Scope is set by the request: a roadmap phase and its linked items, or one database finding or transition by id. Do not widen scope, and do not restate unrelated parts of the plan.
notes: Merged from modernization-slice-rebuild and modernization-item-rebuild (Step 3b item 5). One role, two scopes, selected by the evidence pack: the two prompts differed only in which slice of the plan they were allowed to touch.
